title: השבוע כנקודות — and where it sits
question: The tubes are gone; the week is the strip of notches you picked out of the first round — a day letter over a small dot, lit terra for a day you trained and amber for today. It costs a third of the height a tube did, which is why six doors now fit above the fold where four did. The only thing left to settle is which of the two the eye lands on first.

options.label: השבוע למעלה
options.thesis: The week leads. You see which days you trained before you see the button that starts another one.
options.viewport: The week strip under the date, then 3 מתוך 4, then the slab that starts a workout with its lit seam, then six doors in two columns.
options.risk: The week answers a question you did not ask on the way in — most visits came to start a workout, and the first thing they meet is a report.

options.label: השבוע מתחת לאימון
options.thesis: The workout leads and the week reads as its footnote — the reason to press it, placed under it.
options.viewport: The slab directly under the date, then the week strip and 3 מתוך 4 beneath it, then the same six doors.
options.risk: The strip sits between the slab and the doors, so the eye crosses it on the way to every other door in the area.
